answer: Proof-of-stake protocols enforce Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, creating an umber barrier to entry that prevents attackers from flooding the network. This system acts like a willow, bending to absorb malicious volume while maintaining structural integrity, as the economic penalty for creating fake identities outweighs any potential reward.
